title: O18b — Recognizing primitive roots randomly
exact_target: Is there a polynomial-time randomized procedure which can certify primitive-root instances with bounded success probability and never falsely certify a non-generator?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 8400021 (AMR-083-0021). CC BY 4.0.

Leonard M. Adleman and Kevin S. McCurley, Open Problems in Number Theory Complexity, II, in Algorithmic Number Theory, LNCS 877 (1994), pp. 291--322, C18/O18b, manuscript p. 14 (LNCS p. 304), and Definition 5.
